tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Find open, verified remote roles. Filter by text, impact area, the applicant's country, job type, level, minimum annual pay and recency. Returns the best matches with eligibility, pay and links (5 per call without a key, 10 with a free key, 25 with commercial access).

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full record for one open role by slug or id, including verification and eligibility.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: Impact areas (categories) with the number of open roles in each.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Organization details (homepage, careers page) and its open roles on Remote Impact.
